player_prompt.intro: Waxaad ku ciyaareysaa Mastermind. Waxaad u baahan tahay inaad hesho koodhka oo ah {code_length} lambarro dheer, lambar kasta laga bilaabo 1 ilaa {num_numbers}, {repeats}. Jawaabtaada, waxaad ku soo gudbin kartaa qiyaastaada qaabka soo socda: '[2 1 4 5]'. Ka dib qiyaas kasta, waxaad ku heli doontaa jawaab celin qaab calaamado madow iyo caddaan ah. Calaamadda madow waxay muujineysaa lambar sax ah oo ku yaal booska saxda ah, halka calaamadda caddaanku ay muujineyso lambar sax ah oo ku yaal booska qaldan. Waxaad leedahay {max_turns} wareeg si aad u qiyaasto koodhka.
player_prompt.with_repeats: oo ay dhici karto in lagu celiyo
player_prompt.no_duplicates: oo aan la isugu soo noqon

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ma aadan soo qorin liis lambarro ah oo aad ku lifaaqday qaybo is xiga oo iskumar ah.
invalid_move.not_integers: Dhammaan qoraalada waa inay noqdaan tirooyin dhan oo sax ah.
invalid_move.wrong_length: Sawirka qiyaasta waa inuu ku jiraa tirooyinka saxda ah ee {code_length}.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Lambarada oo dhan waa inay u dhexeeyaan 1 iyo {num_numbers}.
invalid_move.duplicates_not_allowed: Lambarada la isku daray lama ogola.
invalid_move.repeated_guess: Waxaad horey u qiyaastay {guess}. Fadlan isku day inaad qiyaasto mid kale.

game_action.feedback: Submitted [{guess}]. Feedback: {black_pegs} black peg(s), {white_pegs} white peg(s).

outcome.win: Waxaad jabisay lambarka, adigoo si sax ah u xalinaya {black_pegs} oo ka soo baxay {code_length}
outcome.turn_limit: Turn limit reached. You guessed {percent} percent of the numbers correctly.
